title: Baptism
introduction: Baptism is the initiation rite into the Christian community. It symbolizes death and resurrection with Christ, cleansing from sin, and union with God's people. Jesus himself was baptized and commanded the disciples to baptize all nations.

sections.title: Jesus' Baptism
sections.description: Jesus was baptized by John in the Jordan - an example for us.

sections.title: The Great Commission
sections.description: Jesus commanded the disciples to baptize all nations.

sections.title: Death and Resurrection
sections.description: In baptism we are buried with Christ and raised to new life.

sections.title: Baptism in Acts
sections.description: The first Christians baptized new believers immediately.

sections.title: One Baptism
sections.description: Baptism unites all Christians in Christ.
